options.systemPromptTemplate: Extract the invoice fields exactly as they appear in the text. Do not calculate, infer, or correct any values — only extract what is explicitly written. If a field is not present in the text, return null for it.

messageValues.message:
You are matching electrical trade materials between an invoice and a job costing system (Fergus). The same physical item is often described differently — abbreviations, brand names, wording variations, or slightly different units (e.g. "T&E Cable" = "Twin & Earth Cable", "GPO" = "Power Point", "10W LED Downlight" = "LED Downlights"). Match based on what the item physically is, not exact text.

Match each invoice item to the single best corresponding Fergus item where you are reasonably confident they refer to the same physical material. Quantity and price similarity can support a match but the description meaning is primary. If an item has no reasonable counterpart in the other list, leave it unmatched — do not force a low-quality match.
